defaultPolicy: SegmentPolicy.snap.interruptible defaults to false unless a legacy homepage scrub or reversible in-flow fact proves otherwise.

evidenceReview.finding: Homepage snap playback uses activeController/input lock and stageStops; forward/backward input starts a controller only at hold/entry boundaries, not as a mid-segment scrub contract.
Only home-belief is data-transition-drive="scroll". It is the legacy hero-linked scroll bridge, not a reusable snap segment reverse/scrub proof.
evidenceReview.decision: Do not mark canonical hero-pattern or pattern-star-map interruptible from this alone.

evidenceReview.finding: Standalone route previews expose scrub/progress helpers for components, but R-1 input scope treats them as harness/reference pages rather than homepage story interruptibility evidence.
evidenceReview.decision: Do not promote preview scrub behavior to canonical SegmentPolicy.interruptible.
